profile.tagline: I build full-stack web applications: backend systems and REST APIs with C# and .NET, SQL Server databases and responsive frontends.
about: I'm a full-stack .NET developer with 2 years of commercial experience building and maintaining business web applications with ASP.NET, .NET Core and Microsoft SQL Server.

On the backend I build REST APIs, services and business logic in C#, design databases and write SQL queries and stored procedures. On the frontend I create responsive pages and UI improvements with JavaScript, HTML, CSS and Bootstrap.
I enjoy improving existing systems as much as building new ones: debugging, optimizing and keeping enterprise applications reliable.

My background also includes system and embedded programming in C on Linux, and a Master's degree in Software Engineering and Artificial Intelligence. Alongside development I teach programming, which keeps my fundamentals sharp and my explanations clear.
